text: Sir. SIR. I've seen your brochure. The brochure is BAD.
That's a relay uplink. RR-series. I've seen the SCHEMATIC, it was in a MEMO, memo thirty-eight, I forwarded it to forty billion people, NOBODY READ IT.

Oh, I've been waiting my WHOLE LIFE. ...Cancelled. Cancelled, cancelled, cancelled. Friendship isn't a feature, lady. It's a bug. Nobody patches ours.
